sourceReview.reason: Rechecked full Binance primary press release dated 2026-07-15 (https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/binance-launches-us-stocks-trading-and-previews-bstocks-tokenized-securities-302825381.html): it already announced access to 7,000+ U.S. stocks/ETFs and previewed tokenized equities. Binance's 2026-10-21 bStocks collateral notice (https://www.binance.bh/en/support/announcement/detail/3afa938f499d403382d01d0c0644507e) describes an earlier jurisdiction-restricted feature, not a new 2026-11-13 multi-asset launch. No dated new Binance primary release or two independent full-text reports substantiate the November 13 headline as a fresh event. Hold for six hours; do not recycle the July launch or imply universal availability.
